extraction.Name: Chris Colombe
extraction.NOTES: This document is a questionnaire/sworn statement by Chris Colombe, a third party, regarding his financial dealings with William McCloskey or Dillon. Around 1909 or 1910, Colombe signed a note with Dillon so Dillon could obtain lumber from the Montgomery Lumber Company of Winner, which Colombe ultimately had to pay. From then until about 1919, Colombe arranged credit for Dillon at stores in Colome and provided horses, harness, buggy, piano money, and other items. Colombe purchased land from Dillon for approximately $3,500 cash. At the time of purchase, Dillon still owed Colombe over $800 after deducting the agreed land price. Dillon died without paying this debt. Subscribed and sworn before J. W. Cross, Notary Public, on June 18, 1929 (commission expires 4-28-32). Document references allottee William McCloskey or Dillon, allotment 2331.
